text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Combining sertraline and lithium carries an increased risk of developing serotonin syndrome, a potentially life-threatening condition [sertraline:warnings:9, lithium:drug_interactions:0]. Both drugs are associated with causing serotonin syndrome when used concomitantly [lithium:warnings_and_cautions:13, sertraline:warnings:9]. Additionally, while a clinical trial showed that sertraline did not significantly alter steady-state lithium levels, it is recommended to monitor plasma lithium levels following the initiation of sertraline therapy and make appropriate dose adjustments [sertraline:drug_interactions:3].
